text_en: Bless the Lord , O my soul. O Lord my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty,
text_cn: 我的灵魂，请你向上主颂赞！ 上主我的天主，你伟大无限， 你以尊贵威严作你的衣冠：

text_en: wrapped in light as with a garment. You stretch out the heavens like a tent,
text_cn: 身披光明，好像外氅， 展开苍天，相似棚帐，

text_en: you set the beams of your chambers on the waters, you make the clouds your chariot, you ride on the wings of the wind,
text_cn: 在水上建筑你的宫殿， 造了云彩，作你的车辇， 驾御着风翼，驰骋直前；

text_en: you make the winds your messengers, fire and flame your ministers.
text_cn: 发出暴风，作你的使团， 你以火焰，作你的随员。

text_en: You set the earth on its foundations, so that it shall never be shaken.
text_cn: 你奠定大地于基础之上， 你使大地永远不再动荡；

text_en: You cover it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
text_cn: 以汪洋作氅衣把大地遮盖， 又以大水把群山峻岭掩埋。

text_en: At your rebuke they flee; at the sound of your thunder they take to flight.
text_cn: 你一呵叱，大水即逃避， 你一鸣雷，大水即惊退。

text_en: They rose up to the mountains, ran down to the valleys to the place that you appointed for them.
text_cn: 峻岭向上突出，山谷向下沉落， 各个都停在你那指定的处所。

text_en: You set a boundary that they may not pass, so that they might not again cover the earth.
text_cn: 你划定了界限，都不越过， 免得大水再把大地淹没。

text_en: You make springs gush forth in the valleys; they flow between the hills,
text_cn: 你使水泉成为溪川， 蜿蜒长流于群山间，

text_en: giving drink to every wild animal; the wild asses quench their thirst.
text_cn: 供给各种走兽水喝， 使野驴也得以解渴。

text_en: By the streams the birds of the air have their habitation; they sing among the branches.
text_cn: 天上飞鸟，在水边宿卧， 在枝叶丛中不断鸣叫。

text_en: From your lofty abode you water the mountains; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your work.
text_cn: 你从高楼宫殿上，灌溉山地， 以你出产的果实，饱饫普世；

text_en: You cause the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for people to use, to bring forth food from the earth,
text_cn: 你使青草和植物生出， 喂养牲畜，为给人服务。 又使土地产生出五谷，

text_en: and wine to gladden the human heart, oil to make the face shine, and bread to strengthen the human heart.
text_cn: 美酒，人饮了舒畅心神， 膏油，人用来涂面润身， 面饼，人吃了增强心神。

text_en: The trees of the Lord are watered abundantly, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
text_cn: 上主的乔木饱餐水泽， 黎巴嫩香柏，主手所植。

text_en: In them the birds build their nests; the stork has its home in the fir trees.
text_cn: 鸟类在那里垒窝筑巢， 鹤群以树梢为家安卧。

text_en: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the rocks are a refuge for the coneys.
text_cn: 高山峻岭作羚羊的洞府， 绝壁岩石作野兔的居处。

text_en: You have made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows its time for setting.
text_cn: 你造有月亮以定节季， 太阳自知向西边沉坠。

text_en: You make darkness, and it is night, when all the animals of the forest come creeping out.
text_cn: 你造了黑暗，便有了夜晚， 林中的野兽遂四出狂窜。

text_en: The young lions roar for their prey, seeking their food from God.
text_cn: 少壮的狮子怒吼觅食， 向天主要求食物充饥；

text_en: When the sun rises, they withdraw and lie down in their dens.
text_cn: 太阳升起的时候，它们各自逃避， 回到自己的洞穴，安然卧下休息；

text_en: People go out to their work and to their labor until the evening.
text_cn: 于是人们外出谋生， 各去劳动，直到黄昏。

text_en: O Lord , how manifold are your works! In wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
text_cn: 上主，你的化工，是何其浩繁， 全是你以智慧所创办，你的受造物遍地充满。

text_en: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, creeping things innumerable are there, living things both small and great.
text_cn: 看，汪洋大海，一望无际， 其中水族，不可数计， 大小生物，浮游不息。

text_en: There go the ships, and Leviathan that you formed to sport in it.
text_cn: 在那里有舟有船，往来航行， 还有你造的鳄鱼，戏游其中。

text_en: These all look to you to give them their food in due season;
text_cn: 这一切生物都瞻仰着你， 希望你按时给它们饮食。

text_en: when you give to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are filled with good things.
text_cn: 你一赐给它们，它们便会收集， 你一伸你的手，它们便得饱食。

text_en: When you hide your face, they are dismayed; when you take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.
text_cn: 你若隐藏你的面容，它们便要恐惧， 你若停止它们呼吸，它们就要死去， 就再回到它们所由出的灰土里去。

text_en: When you send forth your spirit, they are created; and you renew the face of the ground.
text_cn: 你一嘘气，万物创成， 你使地面，更新复兴。

text_en: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; may the Lord rejoice in his works—
text_cn: 愿上主的光荣永世无穷， 愿上主喜乐自己的化工！

text_en: who looks on the earth and it trembles, who touches the mountains and they smoke.
text_cn: 他一垂视大地，大地抖颤， 他一触摸群山，群山冒烟。

text_en: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have being.
text_cn: 只要我活着，我要歌颂上主， 只要我存在，我要咏赞上主。

text_en: May my meditation be pleasing to him, for I rejoice in the Lord .
text_cn: 愿我的颂辞使他乐意， 我要常在上主内欢喜。

text_en: Let sinners be consumed from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord , O my soul. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 愿罪人由地上灭迹， 恶人不再存留人世！ 我的灵魂，颂赞上主！ 亚肋路亚。
